newsitem.title: USA: U.S. construction orders, employment on rise --D&B.
newsitem.headline: U.S. construction orders, employment on rise --D&B.

text.p: Construction firms expect sharp increases in orders and employment in their industry over the next three months, according to a survey conducted by Dun & Bradstreet Corp.
The survey of 200 construction executives is compiled monthly.
For January, the survey's Order Books Index for the coming three months doubled to 42 from 21, and the Employment Index climbed to 27 from 13.
The Prices Index dropped to 22 from 24.
"Few firms expect the current soft labor market in the construction industry to continue indefinitely," Joseph Duncan, chief economic adviser to Dun & Bradstreet, said in a statement.
When asked about current conditions, construction executives said production schedules remain above seasonal norms, while employment levels are below seasonal norms, according to the report.
